parts.name: TW01_motor_housing
parts.note: Stationary gearmotor housing. Ø37.3 bore, Ø45 6809 seat, Ø40 61808 seat on the end wall, Ø12.15 bushing locator. 2 M3 heat-set inserts in the rear pillars.

parts.name: TW02_sprocket_hub
parts.note: Rotating 12-tooth bushing sprocket and hub drum; 6809 and 61808 outer-ring seats; 6 M3 × 5.7 heat-set inserts for the cap.

parts.name: TW03_hub_cap
parts.note: Rotating cap with the 21-tooth internal ring gear (m1.5, generated at 7.0 mm). Print in tough PETG or PA, solid infill around the teeth.

parts.name: TW04_bearing_retainer
parts.note: Clamps the 61808 inner ring; held by the six M3 × 10 gearbox face screws.

parts.name: TW05_motor_rear_cap
parts.note: Dust cap over the motor terminals; grommet hole; two M3 × 8 into the housing pillar inserts.

parts.name: TW06_track_frame
parts.note: Right-hand rail. Mirror for the left (TW06_track_frame_left). Final-drive boss with 4 heat-set inserts; recoil channel; M6 captive nut. Right-hand; the left rail is the mirror image (TW06_track_frame_left).

parts.name: TW07_idler_yoke
parts.note: Sliding idler yoke; Ø8 axle bore; spring spigot.

parts.name: TW08_spring_seat
parts.note: Sliding spring seat pushed by the M6 adjuster; spigot is the recoil stop.

parts.name: TW09_channel_nose
parts.note: Front stop of the yoke channel; two M3 × 40 through bolts with captive nuts.

parts.name: 05_track_shoe
parts.note: Triple grouser, 1 mm relief; Ø3 steel pin, 3.2 mm running bores; never print the pins.

parts.name: 07_idler_wheel
parts.note: Twin rail rims, outer guide flanges and bushing clearance; two 608 bearings; non-driven 8 mm steel axle.

parts.name: 08_road_roller
parts.note: Two 608 bearings; twin running surfaces and outer guide flanges, 0.6 mm lateral clearance per side.

parts.name: 10_slew_bearing_housing
parts.note: 2 x 6004 bearings, 40 mm centre separation; ream seats after coupon.

parts.name: 14_slew_pinion
parts.note: Three M3 bolts to 4 mm steel clamp hub; 87.2 mm shaft spacing.

parts.name: 15_slew_motor_mount
parts.note: Body saddle plus steel straps, slots permit .2 mm mesh adjustment.

parts.name: 22_fit_coupon
parts.note: 608 / 6004 / 8 mm axle / 3 mm pin / Ø19.7 18650 cradle groove. Print first; tune hole compensation.

parts.name: 24_return_roller
parts.note: Track R5 carrier: Ø33 rims 0.5 mm above the straight top run so it keeps carrying the sprung track; outer flanges with 0.6 mm side clearance; two 608 bearings.

parts.name: 26_slew_skirt
parts.note: Removable rotating cover, bottom Z92, 12 mm above bridge; M3 captive nuts. Does not carry slew loads.

parts.name: 16_upper_deck
parts.note: R3 Cat 320 plan: 189 mm tail arc, boom-foot nose, perimeter rim; all shells bolt into captive nuts.

parts.name: 18_counterweight
parts.note: Curved 189 mm tail-radius shell; clamps the steel ballast plate with internal ribs; four M4 × 80 into deck nuts.

parts.name: 19_engine_hood
parts.note: Hood shell with service opening, side louvres and valve-cover nose; four M3 × 80 countersunk into deck nuts.

parts.name: 29_hood_hatch
parts.note: Battery service hatch; four M3 × 12 countersunk into nuts captured in the hood bosses.

parts.name: 30_tank_housing
parts.note: Front-right tank housing; reserved controller bay inside; two M3 × 80 countersunk.

parts.name: 31_toolbox_step
parts.note: Front-right toolbox with access step and tread grooves; two M3 × 45 countersunk.

parts.name: 32_exhaust_stack
parts.note: Decorative stack; fit before the hood with an M3 × 8 from inside.

parts.name: 23_equipment_tray
parts.note: Fixed tray for the cell cradle, BMS and converters; legs bolt to the deck with four M3 × 45.

parts.name: 33_cell_cradle
parts.note: Two Ø19.7 grooves at 19.3 mm pitch, 69 mm between end walls; fits datasheet 18650 cells Ø18.0-18.6 × 64.7-65.3 as a welded 2S1P pack.

parts.name: 25_battery_retainer
parts.note: Clamp bar over a 3 mm closed-cell foam pad; two M3 × 20 into side-loaded nuts.

parts.name: 20_cab_frame
parts.note: 120 x 70 x 118 mm cab; Cat 320 drawing proportions, now front-left beside the boom foot.

parts.name: 27_operator_seat
parts.note: Scale interior; M3 through bolts into deck nuts.

parts.name: 28_operator_console
parts.note: Second console sits 50 mm inboard; decorative joystick.
